name: kql-clause-independence
description: WHERE clauses execute independently of earlier unsatisfiable groups: an empty disjoint group does not suppress later clauses, and an uncorrelated NOT cannot falsify the query.
setup: UPSERT { CONCEPT ?drug_type { {type: "$ConceptType", name: "Drug"} SET ATTRIBUTES { "description": "Pharmaceutical drug concept type" } } }
UPSERT { CONCEPT ?symptom_type { {type: "$ConceptType", name: "Symptom"} SET ATTRIBUTES { "description": "Medical symptom concept type" } } }
UPSERT { CONCEPT ?herb_type { {type: "$ConceptType", name: "Herb"} SET ATTRIBUTES { "description": "Declared but never instantiated" } } }

cases.name: a clause after an empty disjoint group still binds its variable
an uncorrelated NOT whose block matches is a no-op
an uncorrelated NOT whose block matches nothing is a no-op
